_comment: DS4 machine tuning profiles. The first entry whose match{chip substring, min_ram_gib} fits this machine is applied: each env var is set as a DEFAULT (setenv overwrite=0), so anything you export yourself still wins. Generate/refresh an entry for your machine with ./tune_profile.sh. Order entries most-specific first.

_backends_reference._doc: Valid 'backend' values for prefill_by_tokens (the resident routed-MoE prefill algorithm). Edit prefill_by_tokens to choose which runs per prefill-chunk token count. ENFORCED today: the engine only auto-switches between a NAX-half backend (nax_half / nax_half_alu) and int8 (nax_int8) via DS4_RESIDENT_MOE_NAX_HALF_MAX_TOKENS (the loader derives it from the highest *half* range's max_tokens + 1). Other backends listed here are selected by their env in the entry's 'env' block; per-token enforcement for them needs a general selector (not built yet), so for them prefill_by_tokens is documentation. NAX backends are M5+ only (matmul2d); on M3/M4 they fall back to mul_mm_id.

mulmm.desc: Upstream mul_mm_id grouped GPU matmul (pure ALU, no NAX). The 'ALU only' baseline. Works on all chips.

nax_int8.desc: NAX int8 matmul2d, compact-bridge fused-dequant. M5 LARGE-chunk winner.
nax_int8.env: DS4_RESIDENT_MOE_MPP_INT8_PREFILL=1 DS4_RESIDENT_MOE_MPP_COMPACT_BRIDGE=1 DS4_RESIDENT_MOE_MPP_FUSED_DEQUANT=1 (+MPP_FORCE=1 to ignore the auto min-tokens gate)

nax_half.desc: NAX half x half matmul2d (no fused gate+up).

nax_half_alu.desc: NAX-half + ALU, Plan A fused gate+up+swiglu. M5 SMALL-chunk winner.

pathc.desc: Path C: i8 in-kernel NAX-parallel-ALU full-fused.
pathc.note: ~tie with nax_int8 on M5 (no cross-kernel NAX/ALU overlap)

ane_gpu.desc: ANE hot experts + grouped GPU(ALU) cold. Correct. The dual-cluster ANE win is M3 Ultra; on M5 Max (single cluster) ANE is ~+6 t/s (GPU-encode-bound).

ane_alu.desc: ANE hot + per-expert int8/ALU cold. DO NOT USE — the per-expert dedup MoE compute is broken (garbage output).

ane_nax.desc: ANE hot + per-expert NAX-half cold. DO NOT USE — broken (per-expert dedup + NAX-half tile corruption).

profiles._comment: M5 Max, MEASURED (81G IQ2XXS, 45s cooldown, alone on box). prefill_by_tokens picks per prefill chunk: nax_half_alu below 7680 tok/chunk, nax_int8 at/above. Measured t/s half-vs-int8: 4096:316/269, 5120:364/309, 6144:395/337, 7168:423/366 (half wins), 8192:378/500 (int8 wins) -> crossover in (7168,8192], boundary=midpoint 7680. Both backends enabled + MPP_FORCE; loader maps ranges to DS4_RESIDENT_MOE_NAX_HALF_MAX_TOKENS=7680.

M3 Ultra: NO NAX (matmul2d is M5-only via ds4_gpu_is_m5_device; nax_half_alu/nax_int8 silently fall back to mul_mm_id), so there is NO per-token GPU-backend split like the M5 entry — the routed GPU path is mul_mm_id at every chunk size, and a nax-style prefill_by_tokens would no-op. M3U's win is DUAL-CLUSTER ANE, gated PER-EXPERT by refs (no per-chunk-token ANE gate exists). refs ~= chunk_tokens/32, so prefill_by_tokens here is informational: it documents the token->refs mapping that ANE_MIN_REFS=64 implies (ANE auto-engages on chunks >~2048 tokens and scales up). To get MEASURED M3U numbers, run tune_profile.sh ON the M3U (this box is M5 Max; M3U cannot be benchmarked here). DS4_FLASH_MOE_ANE_DUAL=1 lights both ANE clusters on the SSD/slot-bank path.
